latest_snapshot_note: The latest daily chart snapshot is not compared with this older 2026-11-13 official extract; differences between dates are not classified as parser errors. The latest capture is never rewritten to match the older transcription: its rows are the parse of its own fetch and must keep their own capture timestamp.
current_capture_divergence_note: Slots whose ordered player list differs between the dated official transcription and the latest capture, listed in data/live/depth_capture_divergence.csv. Capture movement, not a defect, and not a claim about who starts.
scope_note: four of 32 clubs (WAS, NYG, DET, NE), the two week-10 matchups used by the lineup-deficiency page. A sample, not a census.
